// diagnostic

E3012

Stack overflow in `{fn}`

What

Stack overflow in `{fn}`

Why

The call stack kept growing without reaching a safe return.

Fix

End the recursion or make progress toward a base case.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3012: tests/ui/runtime_e3012.stderr.

 Fix: end the recursion or make progress toward a base case.
